title: Linear Stuff
description: This mod adds things that aren't so linear, things that aren't so logical, either.
body:
This mod adds things that aren't so linear, things that aren't so logical, either.

Mainly built for survival; Find new resources underground, craft machines to help you create

new items, and use linear things to discover non-linear worlds.

 

This mod works with multiplayer, but this is not a multiplayer mod.

 

I'm adding new things all the time, check back and update the mod occasionally!

 

Enjoy the mod, and comment any ideas for a future update!
